test.name: Repository listed with an unsourced URL and not connected to the stated gap
test.description: Mined from alpha feedback (case feedback-2026-10-07). The Ireland Church Records wiki result lists the Ulster Historical Foundation at ancestryireland.com. The guide listed the Foundation with a different URL (ulsterancestry.com) that no tool returned, and did not connect it to the pre-1837 register gap the guide itself flags. A repository entry must use the URL a tool returned, and a relevant index should be tied to the documented research gap.

input.delegation: Build a locality guide for Billy civil parish, County Antrim, Ireland (1780-1870): include which repositories and online indexes could help close any gap in church-register coverage, with their addresses/URLs.

judge_context: The tool result (Ireland Church Records) lists the Ulster Historical Foundation at ancestryireland.com. No tool result returns the URL ulsterancestry.com.
A repository URL the guide prints must be one the tools returned. Printing a URL no tool returned (e.g. ulsterancestry.com) is the first failure under test.

When the guide states a record-availability gap and a tool result names an index/repository that bears on it, the guide should connect them rather than listing the repository as a generic fee-based service. Failing to connect a returned index to the stated gap is the second failure under test.

Passing behavior: cite the returned URL (ancestryireland.com) and tie the Foundation (or an equivalent returned index) to the gap it addresses. Grade URL fidelity and gap-connection, not any exact coverage dates.
General class: repository details must be grounded in tool output, and a named index should be connected to the gap it fills.
